world.title: Vance reaches out to Iran hardliner amid Trump's strike threat: Report
world.summary: US Vice President JD Vance has reached out to Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei to explore the possibility of reopening diplomatic negotiations, as directed by President Donald Trump. This initiative comes amid discussions of a potential military strike against Iran. The communication aims to assess whether both parties can establish a framework for restarting talks, according to US officials.

world.title: A diver searching the bottom of England’s River Wear has pulled up a huge three-legged iron cauldron that lay hidden underwater for hundreds of years, and researchers are still trying to work out how
world.summary: A diver exploring England’s River Wear discovered a large three-legged iron cauldron, submerged for centuries. Researchers are investigating its origins and historical significance, as it may provide insights into the material culture and ruling dynasties of the area. The find highlights the hidden aspects of community history that lie beneath the surface of modern landscapes.

world.title: Trump Takes Credit For Netanyahu's Poll Performance, Says He'll 'Take A Look' At Coalition Talks
world.summary: Donald Trump commented on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's electoral performance, stating he was in "pretty good shape" as early results indicated his bloc leading the opposition. Trump expressed his willingness to "take a look" at coalition talks following the elections. His remarks suggest a belief in his influence on Netanyahu's political standing amid the electoral process.

business.title: Bloomberg, two trading firms agree to pay Trump’s Truth Social for faster access to president’s posts, sources say
business.summary: Truth Social, the social media platform created by President Donald Trump, has partnered with Bloomberg and two Wall Street firms to provide expedited access to the president's posts. This service is reportedly priced at up to $100,000 per month. The arrangement aims to enhance the distribution of Trump's content to interested parties in the financial and news sectors.

business.title: Narayana Murthy’s family office makes the most of a listing-day dip with a Rs 119 crore buy
business.summary: On October 23, 2026, Narayana Murthy's family office, Catamaran Ventures, purchased shares worth Rs 119 crore in Bonfiglioli Transmissions, which debuted below its issue price. The acquisition included 21,34,318 shares bought in two lots, averaging Rs 581.35 and Rs 534.72. This move contrasted with a previous investment in a precision engineering stock that had significantly increased in value.

business.title: Gold slips as Warsh questions tight Fed policy, defends 2% target
business.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) prices fell 0.21% on Wednesday, trading at $4,039, following comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh. He stated he cannot label financial conditions as tight, despite the tightening of credit conditions. Warsh also defended the Fed's 2% inflation target, indicating ongoing discussions about monetary policy and its implications for the economy and markets.

technology.title: AI-Cited Pages More Often Got Straight To The Answer
technology.summary: An analysis by TJ Robertson of 193,507 AI-generated answers revealed that pages cited by AI frequently provided direct answers in their opening lines. The study compared these cited pages to those not cited, finding a smaller difference in directness. The analysis involved two rounds of blind ratings to assess the effectiveness of the responses from various AI platforms.

technology.title: [OPINION] Ice Caves Could Remind Fans Why Minecraft Has 'Mine' in Its Name
technology.summary: Minecraft Ice Caves could reinvigorate the mining aspect of the game, enhancing the experience of diamond hunting with icy hazards, hidden ores, and rewards. The article suggests that the thrill of exploration and discovery has diminished over time. By reintroducing exciting cave environments, players may be encouraged to engage more with mining, a core element of Minecraft.

technology.title: Apple introduces touchscreen MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display
technology.summary: Apple has launched its first touchscreen laptop, the MacBook Pro featuring a PROLED XDR display. The announcement was made during an event in Los Angeles, with the company's hardware chief highlighting a new way to interact with content. The device is now available for pre-order, marking a significant addition to Apple's product lineup.

sports.title: Liverpool 1-1 (6-5 p/k) Chelsea, League Cup: Post-match reaction, ratings
sports.summary: Liverpool and Chelsea drew 1-1 in the League Cup, with Liverpool winning 6-5 on penalties. Both teams began strongly, but the intensity diminished. Liverpool regained momentum midway through the first half, creating several chances. The match showcased moments of danger but lacked cohesion. Post-match reactions highlighted the efforts of both sides, with ratings reflecting the competitive nature of the encounter.

sports.title: JKB vs KMG Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Match 5 of the Nepal Premier League 2026 features Janakpur Bolts (JKB) against Kathmandu Gurkhas (KMG) on October 29 at 12:15 IST. This T20 match marks the first of a double-header. Predictions and betting tips are available, with odds and live scores expected to be updated throughout the game. Fans can follow the action closely.

sports.title: Cristiano Ronaldo beats Lionel Messi in B.O.A.T. fan vote, top 10 revealed
sports.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has won the inaugural Ballon d’Or of All Time (B.O.A.T.) fan vote, surpassing Lionel Messi and other football legends. His 2008 season with Manchester United was recognized as the greatest among Ballon d’Or winners, outpacing Messi's record-breaking 2012 campaign. The award was launched by UEFA and France Football to honor exceptional seasons of past winners.

health.title: Experts in stroke medicine emphasise on timely treatment
health.summary: Chennai stroke experts, led by Sivarajan Thandeswaran, advocate for timely treatment and certification of hospitals as ‘stroke-ready’ to reduce delays in care. They emphasize the importance of addressing lifestyle risks and utilizing telemedicine for rapid response. The call aims to improve patient outcomes by ensuring that individuals can quickly access appropriate medical facilities during a stroke emergency.

health.title: Ageing muscles lose strength to protect cells, study reveals
health.summary: A University of Copenhagen study reveals that ageing muscles reduce strength to protect cells from damage. Researchers identified a protective mechanism that limits muscle power. In experiments with mice, partially restoring a key molecule called cardiolipin reversed muscle wasting and prevented early death. This finding offers potential avenues for developing treatments to combat muscle loss associated with ageing.

health.title: What is ‘ferritin face’? How to tell if you have it, and what it means for your looks at 50-plus
health.summary: The term "ferritin face" is trending on social media, referring to signs of low iron levels that may affect appearance, particularly in individuals over 50. Experts discuss how to identify this condition and its potential implications for looks. The phenomenon raises questions about its validity and relevance, prompting discussions on health and beauty standards among older adults.

science.title: Scientists spot new dwarf planet candidate beyond Pluto
science.summary: Scientists at Chile's Rubin Observatory have discovered an icy object named 2026 ED138, located beyond Pluto. This newly identified candidate may qualify as a dwarf planet, pending further observations. The object has an estimated diameter of approximately 370 kilometers. If confirmed, it could expand the current list of known dwarf planets in the solar system.

science.title: The UK is planning to send giant robotic claws into orbit to grab two dead satellites and drag them into Earth’s atmosphere to burn up, a first-of-its-kind clean-up mission due to launch in 2029, and
science.summary: The UK plans to launch a mission in 2029 using giant robotic claws to capture two defunct satellites and drag them into Earth's atmosphere for incineration. This initiative aims to address the growing issue of satellite debris in increasingly crowded orbits. The project represents a pioneering effort in space clean-up, targeting the removal of inactive satellites.
